title: Chapter 366 The Dream Crystal Orchid'S True Body
content:
Chapter 366 The Dream Crystal Orchid'S True Body

This scene is like a competition, two people fighting against each other, and then the final champion is decided.

However, the price of this failure is undoubtedly huge.

The battle did not stop for a moment.

Wang Shuo was kicked away by Zuo Da again.

Although Wang Shuo was full of murderous intent, he still had his consciousness. He was not a machine that only knew how to kill, otherwise he would not know how to use supplies.

Spitting out a mouthful of blood, Wang Shuo shook his head lightly.

Zuo Da was good at using a big knife, chopping with great force, and his fist and foot skills were also quite good.

Although Wang Shuo had rich combat experience, he still couldn't catch up with Zuo Da.

Standing up again, Wang Shuo rushed forward again regardless of his own injuries.

Just at this time, another group of monsters rushed in.

These monsters looked very similar to humans, but more like apes. They were on all fours, very good at climbing, and moved quickly.

The four were immediately surrounded.

The four people who were fighting against each other immediately dealt with this monster.

This kind of monster is native to the mine, named Ghost Monkey, and has been controlled by the Dream Crystal Orchid. The Dream Crystal Orchid itself has no fighting power, so these ghost monkeys are considered her guard beasts.

The battle is coming to an end, and they are here to clear the field.

More than ten ghost monkeys gathered around Wang Shuo, and the ghost monkeys made a "squeak" sound, and they launched an attack.

Wang Shuo fought hard to kill.

The fighting power of this kind of ghost monkey is still weaker than that of the golden boss, but their bodies are more flexible. Wang Shuo was scratched with several blood marks not long after the battle.

Just when Wang Shuo thought it was okay.

After a while, he felt a little heavy in his body, and he couldn't lift his whole body.

"Oops!"

His heart jumped, he was poisoned!

At this time, the other three people also felt something was wrong.

The slow poison carried by this ghost monkey itself is quite toxic, and the fighting power of several people has dropped rapidly in a short period of time.

Wang Shuo was powerless and could only watch the scars on his body increase.

If it weren't for the armor protecting him, he would have been killed long ago.

But it was obvious that Wang Shuo couldn't hold on for much longer.

Baichuan Zhonggu was the first to be killed, and his head was blown away by the ghost monkey.

Seeing this, Zuo Da made up his mind and immediately took out a black thing.

Then there was a shocking explosion.

"Bang."

Wang Shuo was also in the explosion and was blown to pieces.

There was no living creature in the whole hall.

Fortunately, Wang Shuo still had the resurrection coin.

Under the guidance of the teleportation array in the secret room, Wang Shuo was resurrected in the secret room again.

At this time, his red eyes had returned to normal, and the whole person was no longer controlled by the desire to kill.

Wang Shuo was a little emotional. The resurrection coin was the most powerful prop in the world, nothing else.

It seems that he will have to find a way to get another one in the future. The last resurrection coin in his hand was consumed again.

He quickly looked around the secret room. The whole space was not big. Next to a small teleportation array was a spring, nearly one meter above the ground. Next to the spiritual spring was a gorgeous flower, the Dream Crystal Orchid.

"Ah, how did you get here?"

A sharp female voice sounded, with a hint of panic in it.

Since the birth of spiritual intelligence, the Dream Crystal Orchid has never exposed its body to any human or monster.

Wang Shuo immediately used the reconnaissance skill to check the situation of the Dream Crystal Orchid.

After checking, Wang Shuo finally figured out that it was her who was causing all this.

In order to avoid more trouble, Wang Shuo directly stabbed with a spear.

He killed it in a few seconds.
